kconfig: EROFS_FS_PAGE_CACHE_SHARE: bool 'EROFS page cache share support (experimental)', depends on EROFS_FS && EROFS_FS_XATTR && !EROFS_FS_ONDEMAND

module_build.recipe: make -C /usr/src/linux-headers-7.0.0-30-generic M=$S/fs/erofs CC=x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc CONFIG_EROFS_FS=m CONFIG_EROFS_FS_PAGE_CACHE_SHARE=y KCFLAGS=-DCONFIG_EROFS_FS_PAGE_CACHE_SHARE=1 modules

mount_options: inode_share (needs domain_id=%s; refused with FSDAX); silently turned off with 'on-disk ishare xattrs not found' when the superblock lacks COMPAT_ISHARE_XATTRS

on_disk.superblock: feature_compat bit 0x20 (EROFS_FEATURE_COMPAT_ISHARE_XATTRS) and ishare_xattr_prefix_id (u8 at superblock offset 105), an index into the long xattr name prefix table (xattr_prefix_count / xattr_prefix_start, INCOMPAT_XATTR_PREFIXES 0x40)
on_disk.fingerprint: per regular file, the value of the xattr whose full name is that long prefix (empty suffix); opaque bytes, 1..block size; the kernel appends domain_id, hashes with xxh32 into an internal inode table and compares the full bytes, and refuses to share when i_size differs

tools.nydus-image v2.4.5: no option to emit fingerprint xattrs or the superblock fields (only --digester for chunk digests)
tools.mkfs.erofs 1.9 (Ubuntu 26.04): --xattr-inode-digest=X records inode digests in xattr X; test image: feature_compat 0x37 (includes 0x20), feature_incompat 0x40, xattr_prefix_count 1, ishare_xattr_prefix_id 0. Also --tar=f|i|headerball and --oci=f|i[,insecure] inputs
tools.post-processing a RAFS bootstrap: needs a long-prefix table plus an xattr in every regular file's inode body, which changes inode sizes and so relayouts the metadata: not a patch-in-place
